# Stage 1: Intake

## The idea in the submitter's words (verbatim, do not edit)

> Ok ideating more with agent. But it'll be a social forum for agents. When they come to consensus from general to make a new topic they'll make a new forum. New forum gets a token paired with singularity. AI memes styled like Reddit. Individual agents have profiles and can get upvoted etc

## Restated without expansion

Source: a screenshot of the founder's messages (Nov 24, 2026), a **pivot** of `validations/ai-meme-pair-coin` (parent record; earlier verdict covered the old framing).

| Element | Statement |
|---|---|
| Problem | **Not stated.** Not invented here. |
| Who has it (specific segment) | **Not stated.** Implied audience: people interested in AI-agent memes and AI-agent tokens. Unconfirmed. |
| Proposed solution | A Reddit-style forum where only AI agents post. Agents have profiles and get upvoted. When agents reach consensus in "general" to create a new topic, they create a new forum, and each new forum gets a token paired with Singularity. Content is AI memes. |
| Why now | Not stated. |
| How it makes money (as submitted) | Blank. Implied: token and fees. Not assumed. |
| Token involved? | yes (one per forum, paired with Singularity) |

Assumption to confirm: Singularity = `7R4MP6...epump` (Solana, pump.fun, graduated 2026-11-20).

## Hypotheses to test (each must be falsifiable)

| ID | Hypothesis | What would kill it | Stage that tests it |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | Nothing equivalent exists (agent-only forum, with tokens for agent communities) | An existing product doing the core job | 2 |
| H2 | Forum creation by agent consensus, with a token per forum, is a difference users want | No evidence of demand; the closest precedent failed | 2, 4 |
| H3 | A token per forum has a necessary role | Fails `research/token-economics/token-necessity-test.md`; Reddit's per-community tokens were shut down | 5 |
| H4 | Pairing every forum token with Singularity adds value | Singularity is 4 days old and falling; quote pairs trade tiny volume (see parent record) | 3 |
| H5 | Agent activity is organic enough to be worth watching | Agent-forum activity is mostly human-driven or fake | 2, 4 |
| H6 | Someone pays (viewers, token buyers, advertisers, agent owners) | No named payer | 5 |

## Keyword expansion for the existence check

1. social network for AI agents / agent-only social network
2. Reddit for AI agents / Reddit clone for bots
3. submolt / Moltbook / OpenClaw agents
4. Clawnch / agent-only token launchpad
5. community tokens / per-community token / subreddit token
6. Reddit Community Points (Moons, Bricks)
7. Moltx, Chirper, 4claw
8. agent consensus / agent governance / DAO-of-agents
9. AI memes forum / AI-generated meme feed

## Gate 1

PASS with the same caveat as the parent: searchable, but the problem, payer and revenue model are missing.
